verses.pali: “Pañcimāni, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni, yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five kinds of suffering that particularly apply to ladies. They’re undergone by ladies and not by men.

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, mātugāmo daharova samāno patikulaṁ gacchati, ñātakehi vinā hoti.
verses.english: Firstly, a lady, while still young, goes to live with her husband’s family and is separated from her relatives.

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa paṭhamaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: This is the first kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo utunī hoti.
verses.english: Furthermore, a lady undergoes the menstrual cycle.

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa dutiyaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: This is the second kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo gabbhinī hoti.
Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa tatiyaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: This is the third kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

verses.pali: Idaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa catutthaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: This is the fourth kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

verses.pali: Puna caparaṁ, bhikkhave, mātugāmo purisassa pāricariyaṁ upeti.
verses.english: Furthermore, a lady provides services for a man.

verses.pali: Idaṁ kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmassa pañcamaṁ āveṇikaṁ dukkhaṁ, yaṁ mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehi.
verses.english: This is the fifth kind of suffering that particularly applies to ladies.

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa āveṇikāni dukkhāni, yāni mātugāmo paccanubhoti, aññatreva purisehī”ti.
verses.english: These are the five kinds of suffering that particularly apply to ladies. They’re undergone by ladies and not by men.”
